env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[!symlink] skip 'symlink unavailable'
symlink m/link.go -> ../outside/real.go
cd m

logos build ./...
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/run-before.txt
cp ../outside/real.go $WORK/outside-real.orig
logos next --fix
stdout 'tasks in next_tasks.json'
exists main.lgo
exists link.go
! exists link.lgo
cmp ../outside/real.go $WORK/outside-real.orig

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nextsymlink

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hi")
}

-- outside/real.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func Real(name string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("hello %s", name)
}
